answer.book: Daneau's Vetustissimarum primi mundi antiquitatum sectiones seu libri IIII (1590): a Latin treatise in four sections on the first age of the world, from creation to the Flood. Each section has a title, four chapters (capita) with numbered historical items and disputed questions (Ad I, Ad II...), and the book opens with a dedication, a proem and an index.
